title: Observe European clan alias during ordinary boot
changes: Record the bounded ordinary-boot reachability check for the European clan graphics table alias.
validation: One isolated Windows audit build and one Wine observation of the existing 1200-frame clean-boot input record no bus requests in the alias range and no dropped events; 92 protected inputs and 688 frozen source hashes remain unchanged.
limitations: The bus audit excludes folded constants and unselected host readers; this bounded negative does not prove global absence. Positive ordinary use, full scene comparison, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurement.
